const cfg = JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('caseConfig'));
const tc = cfg.id; const raw = pm.response.text() || ''; let json={}; try{json=raw?pm.response.json():{};}catch(e){}
function statusMatches(spec, code){ if(Array.isArray(spec)) return spec.map(Number).includes(Number(code)); return Number(spec)===Number(code); }
function render(v){ return String(v||'').replaceAll('{{fr17RunId}}', pm.environment.get('fr17RunId') || ''); }

function send(opts){ opts.header=Object.assign({},opts.header||{}, {'X-Student-Id': pm.environment.get('studentId') || '23127475'}); return new Promise(resolve=>pm.sendRequest(opts,(err,res)=>resolve({err,res}))); }

async function listCoupons(){ const res=await send({url:(pm.environment.get('baseUrl')||'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/coupons', method:'GET', header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+(pm.environment.get('adminToken')||'')}}); try{return res.res.json();}catch(e){return [];} }
function asArray(d){ if(Array.isArray(d))return d; if(Array.isArray(d.coupons))return d.coupons; if(Array.isArray(d.data))return d.data; return []; }
function byCode(list,code){return list.filter(c=>String(c.code)===String(code));}

async function deleteId(id){ if(!id)return; await send({url:(pm.environment.get('baseUrl')||'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/admin/coupons/' + id, method:'DELETE', header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+(pm.environment.get('adminToken')||'')}}); }
pm.test(tc + ' status matches expected', () => pm.expect(statusMatches(cfg.status, pm.response.code), 'expected '+JSON.stringify(cfg.status)+', got '+pm.response.code).to.equal(true));
pm.test(tc + ' no unexpected 5xx', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

if(raw && !(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.allowNonJson)) pm.test(tc + ' content type is JSON when body is present', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.include('application/json'));
if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.responseTime) pm.test(tc + ' response time below 1000ms', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000));
if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.error) pm.test(tc + ' response has message or error', () => pm.expect(typeof json.message==='string'||typeof json.error==='string').to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&(cfg.assertions.successCreate||cfg.assertions.successCreateIf2xx)&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success create response has message or id', () => pm.expect(Boolean(json.message||json.id||json.coupon_id)).to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.identityOrMessage&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success response has identity or message', () => pm.expect(Boolean(json.id||json.coupon_id||json.message)).to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.jsonContentType&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success response content type is JSON', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')||'').to.include('application/json'));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noSensitive) pm.test(tc + ' response does not leak credentials/tokens', () => ['password','password_hash','token','jwt'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include(k)));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noStack) pm.test(tc + ' response does not expose stack/sql internals', () => ['stack','trace','sqlite','sql syntax','exception'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include(k)));
if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noScriptReflect) pm.test(tc + ' response does not reflect executable script payload', () => pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include('<script>'));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.deleteSuccess) pm.test(tc + ' delete response has success shape when body exists', () => { if(raw) pm.expect(Boolean(json.message||json.success===true)).to.equal(true); });

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noCreateSchema) pm.test(tc + ' GET admin coupons does not return create success schema', () => { pm.expect(json.message==='Coupon created').to.not.equal(true); pm.expect(json).to.not.have.property('id'); });

(async()=>{ const a=cfg.assertions||{}; let list=null; if(a.listContains||a.listAbsent||a.listSingleCode||a.originalUnchanged) list=asArray(await listCoupons()); if(a.listContains){const code=render(a.listContains); pm.test(tc+' list contains created coupon code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.be.at.least(1));} if(a.listAbsent){const code=render(a.listAbsent); pm.test(tc+' list does not contain rejected/removed code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.equal(0));} if(a.listSingleCode){const code=render(a.listSingleCode); pm.test(tc+' list has exactly one coupon with duplicate code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.equal(1));} if(a.originalUnchanged){const exp=a.originalUnchanged; const found=byCode(list,render(exp.code))[0]||{}; pm.test(tc+' duplicate request does not overwrite original fields',()=>{pm.expect(found.type).to.equal(exp.type); pm.expect(Number(found.discount_value)).to.equal(Number(exp.discount_value)); pm.expect(Number(found.min_order_amount)).to.equal(Number(exp.min_order_amount));});} if(json.id) await deleteId(json.id); if(cfg.setupIdKey) await deleteId(pm.environment.get(cfg.setupIdKey)); })();

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.error) pm.test(tc + ' response has message or error', () => pm.expect(typeof json.message==='string'||typeof json.error==='string').to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&(cfg.assertions.successCreate||cfg.assertions.successCreateIf2xx)&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success create response has message or id', () => pm.expect(Boolean(json.message||json.id||json.coupon_id)).to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.identityOrMessage&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success response has identity or message', () => pm.expect(Boolean(json.id||json.coupon_id||json.message)).to.equal(true));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.jsonContentType&&pm.response.code<300) pm.test(tc + ' success response content type is JSON', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')||'').to.include('application/json'));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noSensitive) pm.test(tc + ' response does not leak credentials/tokens', () => ['password','password_hash','token','jwt'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include(k)));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noStack) pm.test(tc + ' response does not expose stack/sql internals', () => ['stack','trace','sqlite','sql syntax','exception'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include(k)));
if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noScriptReflect) pm.test(tc + ' response does not reflect executable script payload', () => pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase()).to.not.include('<script>'));

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.deleteSuccess) pm.test(tc + ' delete response has success shape when body exists', () => { if(raw) pm.expect(Boolean(json.message||json.success===true)).to.equal(true); });

if(cfg.assertions&&cfg.assertions.noCreateSchema) pm.test(tc + ' GET admin coupons does not return create success schema', () => { pm.expect(json.message==='Coupon created').to.not.equal(true); pm.expect(json).to.not.have.property('id'); });

(async()=>{ const a=cfg.assertions||{}; let list=null; if(a.listContains||a.listAbsent||a.listSingleCode||a.originalUnchanged) list=asArray(await listCoupons()); if(a.listContains){const code=render(a.listContains); pm.test(tc+' list contains created coupon code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.be.at.least(1));} if(a.listAbsent){const code=render(a.listAbsent); pm.test(tc+' list does not contain rejected/removed code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.equal(0));} if(a.listSingleCode){const code=render(a.listSingleCode); pm.test(tc+' list has exactly one coupon with duplicate code',()=>pm.expect(byCode(list,code).length).to.equal(1));} if(a.originalUnchanged){const exp=a.originalUnchanged; const found=byCode(list,render(exp.code))[0]||{}; pm.test(tc+' duplicate request does not overwrite original fields',()=>{pm.expect(found.type).to.equal(exp.type); pm.expect(Number(found.discount_value)).to.equal(Number(exp.discount_value)); pm.expect(Number(found.min_order_amount)).to.equal(Number(exp.min_order_amount));});} if(json.id) await deleteId(json.id); if(cfg.setupIdKey) await deleteId(pm.environment.get(cfg.setupIdKey)); })();
